title: Will Atkinson at Botanic House
description:
Will Atkinson coming to Botanic House

Will Atkinson is one of electronic music's most electrifying forces, renowned for his explosive, high-energy sets that blur the lines between trance, techno, hard dance and beyond. With 20 Beatport No. 1s, millions of streams, a BBC Radio 1 Residency and performances at Tomorrowland, Ultra, EDC, Creamfields and more, the Scottish DJ has built a global reputation for unforgettable party moments. Expect massive anthems, relentless energy and a dancefloor experience that refuses to let up—this is Will Atkinson at full throttle.
address: The Botanic House, 9-11 Castle St, Inverness, IV2 3DX
